title: PLDT Home powers creator-fan connections at GGCON onKOL 2026

blocks.text: So much of what makes gaming memorable happens online – from keeping a match close to exchanging jokes that carry over into the next session. At Good Game Convention (GGCON): onKOL, the Philippines’ hottest content creators, streamers, and online communities who share these moments got to be in the same room for one fine day.

blocks.caption: Content creator Carlos Benipayo joins fellow gaming enthusiasts at GGCON onKOL 2026 powered by PLDT Home Fiber

blocks.text: Organized by the creative minds behind RotoboxPH and GosuGaming, GGCON onKOL 2026 recently brought together some of the biggest names in gaming such as PeenoisePlays, Razzie Binx, Mika Daime, Riku, and SuperMJ at Metrotent Convention Center, Pasig City.

The country’s leading digital services provider PLDT Home found itself right at the heart of the action as the official broadband partner, powering the passions of the local gaming industry as it flourishes further.

GGCON is a vibrant, community-driven celebration of everything to love about modern internet and gaming culture. From video games and anime to portable audio and live streaming, the conference bridges the gap between online icons and the audiences who cheer them on.

Following the massive success of its first leg in April, GGCON onKOL gave fans the rare chance to step away from the chat box and connect face-to-face with their gaming idols. With exclusive creator booths, limited-edition drops, and immersive fan experiences, the event was a testament to just how thriving and tight-knit the local creator space has become.

Several creators also brought their entrepreneurial side to the convention, setting up booths where they sold photocards, cookies, merchandise, and products from their own businesses. These spaces became more than just merch stalls; they gave creators an opportunity to share and showcase another side of themselves, introduce their ventures, and spend time with fans who wanted to support them.

blocks.caption: From gaming tournaments and cosplay showcases to creator meet-and-greets, GGCON: onKOL 2026 brought the ever-passionate local gaming community together

blocks.text: By powering gaming industry events like GGCON onKOL, PLDT Home champions the everyday players, digital storytellers, and passionate fandoms that keep this culture alive. Beyond just providing fast and reliable fiber internet, PLDT Home celebrates the shared experiences that happen when people are truly connected.
